title: 上海高考翻译背诵-81-SSP高考专刊

items.zh: 看到奶奶有些睡意,他拉上窗帘并把电视的音量调低了。
items.en: Seeing that her grandma seemed a little sleepy, he drew the curtains and turned down the volume of the TV.

items.zh: 每周三,这些大学生雷打不动地前往孤儿院做志愿者服务,教孩子们剪纸和编织。
items.en: Every Wednesday, these university students make it a rule to volunteer at the orphanage, teaching children there paper-cutting and weaving.

items.zh: 当针对航天任务进行训练时,这些字航员没法洗澡,只吃航天食品,并且尝试在巨大的噪音中人睡。
items.en: When training for space missions, these astronauts can’t take showers, have to eat only space foods, and attempt to fall asleep amid loud noise.

items.zh: 胡同不仅连接了北京的街道和社区,还联系着北京的过去和现在,证明北京是一座古老而现代的城市。
items.en: Hutongs not only connect Beijing’s streets and communities, but also link its past and present, showing that Beijing is a historic and modern city.
